newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: FORECAST - Dutch July-Sept s/a jobless seen down.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Dutch July-Sept s/a jobless seen down.

text.p: Economists polled by Reuters expect official data due on Thursday to show Dutch seasonally adjusted unemployment down in the latest July-Sept period near 433,000 from 439,000 during the June-August period.

Opinion is split on the direction of the non-seasonally adjusted figure, with three of five economists polled predicting a fall in the number out of work from June-August's 433,000 and two seeing a rise.
The Dutch statistics office (CBS) presents unemployment statistics as rolling three-month averages, based on job centre registrations and a monthly labour force survey.
